// Schema generation fallback
// Request: A comprehensive fullstack Knowledge Base and Note Taking application built with an Express.js REST API backend and Prisma ORM for robust relational schema handling of notebooks, rich markdown notes, and tag associations. The frontend is a clean, responsive dark-mode React dashboard incorporating collapsible sidebar navigation, live-rendered split-pane markdown editing, instant fuzzy searching, multi-tag filtering, and robust export capabilities.

INFERRED FEATURE SPECIFICATIONS (implement ALL of these):
- Relational Data Management with Prisma & Express: Exposes robust REST API endpoints to handle CRUD operations on relational database tables for Notebooks, Notes, and Tags, complete with cascading deletes, safe schema migrations, and relational mapping via Prisma Client. [express, @prisma/client, zod, cors] (Express HTTP Request → Zod Validation Middleware → Prisma Client Query → Relational DB Transaction → JSON Response)
- Live-Rendered Split-Pane Markdown Editor: An interactive markdown editor utilizing real-time rendering, auto-saving logic, code syntax highlighting, and GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) support, paired with seamless inline tag input. [react-markdown, remark-gfm, react-syntax-highlighter, lodash.debounce] (User editor input → Debounced local state changes → Autosave Axios request to API → Rendered HTML/GFM output)
- Instant Fuzzy Search & Dynamic Tag Filter Engine: A client-side fuzzy search filter searching titles, content, and tags in real-time, coupled with a faceted multi-select tag picker in the sidebar to narrow down notes dynamically. [fuse.js, lucide-react] (User search query/selected tags → Front-end state filtering → Screen reader accessible UI update of note listings)
- Collapsible Sidebar & Responsive Layout Layout: A modern, highly accessible dark-mode UI containing collapsible folders, global quick-actions, keyboard shortcuts (CMD/Ctrl + K search), and stateful toggles preserved via LocalStorage. [clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react] (Viewport resize / user toggle action → Layout state update → LocalStorage synchronization)
- Multi-Format Export & Document Parsing: Provides clean utility hooks for users to export their compiled markdown notes directly to standard formats like Markdown (.md), JSON backups, or portable PDFs. [file-saver, jspdf] (Note editor data → Parse to raw text / PDF Canvas → Trigger client browser download pipeline)
- Elegant State Management, Loaders & Empty States: Global loading indicators, skeletal screens, error bounds, and actionable empty-state illustrations guiding users to create their first notebook or tag. [@tanstack/react-query, axios] (React Query hook fetches state → Conditional render: Skeleton loader OR Empty fallback view OR Notes Content list)

Required libraries: express, @prisma/client, zod, cors, react-markdown, remark-gfm, react-syntax-highlighter, lodash.debounce, fuse.js, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, file-saver, jspdf, @tanstack/react-query, axios

Feature folders: server/routes, server/controllers, prisma, client/src/components, client/src/hooks, client/src/context, client/src/utils

Each feature listed above is REQUIRED. Do not omit any of them.
Implement every data flow end-to-end. No mocked data. No placeholder UI.


DESIGN SYSTEM — MANDATORY USAGE:
A design system has been pre-generated at src/design-system/.
You MUST import reusable components from there:
  import { Button, Skeleton, EmptyState } from '../design-system/index.js';

Design Language for this project: elegant (inspired by Linear/Vercel/Stripe)
Color palette: blue brand + slate neutral
Spacing: 8px grid (multiples of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16...)
Border radius: md (consistent across ALL components)
Font: Inter

FORBIDDEN UI PATTERNS:
  ✗ Different border radii on different components (e.g. some rounded-2xl, some rounded-lg)
  ✗ Arbitrary gradient backgrounds not matching the brand palette
  ✗ Buttons larger than 56px height
  ✗ More than 4 different font sizes in a single view
  ✗ Inconsistent spacing that breaks the 8px grid
  ✗ Excessive glassmorphism (max 1 blur panel per page)
  ✗ Missing hover/focus/active states on ANY interactive element
  ✗ Icon-only buttons without aria-label
  ✗ No visible focus indicator (outline-none without focus-visible replacement)

REQUIRED UI PATTERNS:
  ✓ Every interactive element has hover + focus-visible state
  ✓ Destructive actions show a confirmation step before executing
  ✓ Every async operation has a loading skeleton (not just a spinner)
  ✓ Every data-absent state has an EmptyState component with a call-to-action
  ✓ Error states show the actual error message + a recovery action
  ✓ All inputs have labels (visible or aria-label)
  ✓ Responsive at sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px) breakpoints
